meta.name: McGregor Forever
meta.description: Conor McGregor's brutal strikes and trash-talking swagger made him the UFC's biggest draw. This rousing documentary series follows his dynamic career.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: McGregor returns from a two-year break to face the undefeated Khabib Nurmagomedov. With bad blood boiling over, the stunning outcome sparks mayhem.

videos.title: As Real as It Gets
videos.overview: A pivotal fight against Donald Cerrone stuns the Las Vegas crowd. Later, when the COVID-19 pandemic shuts down the world, McGregor fears losing momentum.

videos.title: Insane to This Game
videos.overview: McGregor makes an announcement that has MMA pundits skeptical. Shortly afterward, he starts a brutal weight-cutting routine to take on Dustin Poirier.

videos.title: 'Til the Day I Go Out
videos.overview: Amid doubts about his will to win, McGregor trains for a match with a rival. As the bout ends painfully, the fighter faces next steps.
